basic_profile.bio: RetroFuturist42 is an enthusiast of all things cyberpunk and retro-futurism. Living in the vibrant tech hub of Austin, Texas, they work as a freelance graphic designer. When not immersed in digital art, they can be found strumming their bouzouki or diving deep into the latest episodes of The Simpsons Tapped Out game. Their love for aquariums inspired them to start a small reef tank at home. Typically online during late evenings, they enjoy unwinding by exploring music from bands like Fleet Foxes or solving mysteries with Conan Edogawa from 'One Truth Prevails'. Currently single, they enjoy the freedom to explore their eclectic interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Their expertise in graphic design is largely self-taught, refined through years of practice and online tutorials. They have a knack for identifying visual references and inspirations, like the connection between Misty and Pris from Bladerunner, due to their interest in film and art.
